scope: AST-only tooling; no application import, provider request or AWS operation
defect: Impossible calls could contribute fabricated read/write lineage; extra keywords could replace unrelated lexical globals.
repair: Respect positional-only, keyword-only, required, default and variadic parameters.
Reject proven duplicate, missing, excessive and unexpected arguments before walking a body.
Keep unknown expansions unresolved and extra keyword names inside their declared mapping.
Reject duplicate storage-call keywords and retain real executor callback arity for unknown iterables.
limitations: Static source possibility is not runtime execution proof.
Dynamic return values and unknown expansions remain unresolved.
No new live production fault or native publication acceptance is claimed.
